summary: The job-1325 exit-record wrapper was repaired in a versioned script and passed a no-model MZ73 preflight. The independently validated 18-structure payload was accepted for local sampling, and seven reviewed SIGMA=0.20 eV NSW=0 VASP force-label inputs were prepared but not submitted.

payload.objective: Obtain compatible VASP force labels for the seven reviewed round-0 MatRIS/AQCat25 fallback samples, then measure MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors separately.
current_evidence: The original job-1325 script remains hash-preserved. The repaired v2 script SHA-256 is 14bc500bcf7dbb92881193ef12184cc8bae77956b5c1e242075baf8eed8c2c35 and explicitly includes the runtime artifact writer before model execution.
A no-model MZ73 wrapper preflight wrote a success exit record with preflight_only=true; no GPU prediction rerun was performed.
The job-1325 prediction payload remains classified separately from the failed wrapper. Remote and local SHA-256 both equal 0bfb9c5a38a2eba30b3e2a90a6322b52a250c9f28b4e273db44b5fffaed7c708.
The accepted payload contains the exact 18 requested 50-atom structures, exact structure and checkpoint hashes, finite model energies, and complete finite all-atom forces.

Fallback scoring selected pre_09, pre_04, pre_12, fail_12, pre_06, pre_11, and pre_07. The last-valid/first-failure boundary pair, TS-like point, rising and falling coverage, and maximum external-auditor disagreement are retained.
Seven VASP force-label directories passed structure/input audit under NSW=0, IBRION=-1, ISMEAR=1, SIGMA=0.20 eV, LORBIT=11, ENCUT=400 eV, PBE, ISPIN=2, and Gamma 5x5x1. No VASP job was submitted.
This fallback has no real MatRIS committee and makes no calibrated uncertainty, DFT accuracy, TS, or barrier claim.
payload.one_executable_step: After separate explicit authorization, submit exactly the reviewed seven-structure VASP static force-label batch on sunboquan-codex, preserving the batch hash and preventing duplicate submission. Do not submit fine-tuning, path rerun, micro-NEB, or Dimer work.
payload.submission_boundary: Local review and submission-preflight preparation are allowed. VASP submission requires separate bounded authorization for batch SHA-256 21cdabec5515ea913320dffbe5f6af2f472690bbea3f49878fbf4753c183e750. GPU rerun, MatRIS fine-tuning, complete-path rerun, micro-NEB, and Dimer remain unauthorized.
done_when: All seven exact-structure VASP force labels have authoritative scheduler terminal evidence, normal VASP completion, electronic convergence, complete all-atom forces, and total plus atom-resolved magnetic moments.
MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP energy/force errors are assessed separately without treating two-model disagreement as calibrated uncertainty.
The active-learning controller decides whether MatRIS requires replay-buffer fine-tuning or the path may proceed to the least-cost VASP TS refinement gate.
